subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

Her voice, soft and ________, (shrill) flowed effortlessly through the room.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"shrill"** means a high-pitched and piercing sound. (तेज़ और कर्कश ध्वनि)

 
 
• **Example: **The **shrill** sound of the alarm woke everyone up.
 
 
 
• **"Mellow"** refers to a soft, rich, and pleasant sound. (मधुर)
 
 
• **Example: **Her **mellow** voice was soothing to listen to.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'shrill'** is **'mellow'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Croaky** (गला बैठा हुआ): A rough and low-pitched sound.

 
 
• **Example:** His voice turned **croaky **after shouting for hours.
 
 
 
• **Piercing** (चुभने वाला): A sound that is very high, loud, and sharp.
 
 
• **Example:** The piercing scream echoed through the hall.
 
 
 
• **Nasal** (नाक से बोलना): A sound produced through the nose.
 
 
• **Example:** He spoke in a **nasal **tone that was hard to understand.
 
 

4f:Tc2d,

The correct answer is **Option 3)**
